news.title: Processa Pharmaceuticals Acquires Vidya Therapeutics and Secures $200 Million Financing to Advance BTK Inhibitor Pipeline

PROCESSA PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. ANNOUNCES ACQUISITION OF VIDYA THERAPEUTICS, INC. AND APPROXIMATELY $200 MILLION CONCURRENT PRIVATE PLACEMENT TO ADVANCE BTK INHIBITOR, VT-7208, IN MULTIPLE DISEASE AREAS
